newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Feb bank credit rises 15 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Feb bank credit rises 15 pct on year.

text.p: Bank credit to non-bank customers (in billions of Singapore dollars):
The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) said in its monthly report that bank credit grew marginally faster in February at 15 percent, compared with 14.6 percent year-on-year in January.
Bank loans to non-bank customers accelerated to 14.8 percent from 10.9 percent while loans to the transport sector jumped to 22.4 percent from 17 percent.
Lending to the commerce sector also grew faster by 10.8 percent.
Loans to all other sectors saw slower growth in February.
Credit extended to the manufacturing sector increased by 8.8 percent compared with 10.4 percent in January.
Growth of lending to the building and construction sector, and by professional and private individuals moderated by about one percentage point each, to 19.9 percent and 15.5 percent respectively.
Loans to other sectors expanded at a steady rate of 9.5 percent.
